verdict_a_findings: All 46 inventory case IDs, controls and modes are represented. Popup versus Store reachability and guest/member/admin visibility are generally handled correctly; options heading and profile field behavior match current source.

Every inventory warm/reload case still has one undifferentiated procedure run. Shared setup says reload before first run and repeat after a second reload, but no per-case instruction requires separate warm and post-reload executions, evidence IDs, or observed outcomes. This loses the inventory dimensions for T01-T18, T23-T26; profile edits use reopen as a proxy without explicitly executing extension reload.

T10-T12 combine grant, denial, and no-device outcomes but do not independently run warm and reload for each branch. Split evidence by mode × dimension × branch; absent device/fault conditions must stay unverified, not pass.

T19-T20 and T25-T27 require controlled fault injection but give no runnable setup or fixture/harness reference. They cannot be executed from UI alone; retain inventory coverage and mark these branches blocked/unverified until a named controlled harness is available.

T28 would change device organization and persist profile data. Though it says disposable profiles, it gives no provisioned disposable principal/row instructions. Do not run on a real profile or live org; require dedicated disposable accounts and cleanup evidence first.

T13-T15 options cases promise only page heading/shared SettingsView; the inventory names only Options page entry point, so this is a reasonable observable floor, but the precondition's generic toolbar-popup instruction is inapplicable to these cases and mic-grant cases. Make entrypoint setup conditional per case.
verdict_b_findings: Safety is sound for ordinary profile edits: synthetic values, capture originals, restore after saves; T28 remains unsafe without dedicated fixtures. No invented profile control or role mutation found.

T05-T06 correctly state context identity and ambiguous/missing context are not observable from UI; T19-T20 acknowledge harness need. Keep those assertions out of UI-pass claims until a harness exposes them.

T25 says use visible retry if present, then reopen; current ProfileView has no retry control and hook refresh is internal. The fallback reopen is source-consistent, but failure injection remains unspecified.
T01-T04 preserve guest visibility and signed-in actions; T07-T09 preserve sign-in visibility; T16-T18 preserve the Store direct-sidepanel action. No unsupported UI controls detected.
integrate_after_correction: all warm/reload cases: explicit independent executions and outcomes
T28: named disposable-account provisioning and cleanup
execution_claim: Source/procedure review only; no browser, build, or test run and no UI pass claims.
